items.translation: A：“这家店总是很挤。因为又便宜又好吃吧。”B：“对，而且份量也大，男的也很爱来。”
items.translation_en: A: “This place is always packed. Cheap and tasty, right?” B: “Yes, and on top of that the portions are big, so it's popular with men too.”

items.completed: 客「これも千円ですか。」店員「はい、大きさはちがいますがねだんは同じです。」
items.translation: 客人：“这个也是一千日元吗？”店员：“对，大小不同，价钱一样。”
items.translation_en: Customer: “Is this a thousand yen too?” Clerk: “Yes — the size is different, but the price is the same.”

items.completed: A「スミスさんは今、国に帰っています。」B「そうですか。だから電話しても出ないしメールしても返事が来ないんですね。」
items.translation: A：“史密斯现在回国了。”B：“这样啊。所以打电话也不接、发邮件也不回。”
items.translation_en: A: “Smith is back in his country now.” B: “Ah. That's why he doesn't pick up or reply to email.”

items.completed: 早く夏休みになってほしい。
items.translation: 真希望暑假快点来。
items.translation_en: I want summer vacation to come soon.

items.completed: すみません、もう少しゆっくり言っていただけませんか。
items.translation: 不好意思，能再说慢一点吗？
items.translation_en: Sorry, could you say that a little more slowly?

items.translation: A：“明天星期天，没什么事做。”B：“去动物园怎么样？一个人去也开心。”
items.translation_en: A: “It's Sunday tomorrow and I have nothing to do.” B: “How about the zoo? It's fun even alone.”

items.translation_en: A: “About how old is Tanaka-sensei?” B: “He said he doesn't want people asking his age, so I don't think he's young.”

items.translation_en: Mother: “Ken, where do you want to go today?” Ken: “There's a book I want you to buy me, so I want to go to the bookstore.”

items.completed: 太ってきたので、ダイエットをしようと思っています。
items.translation: 胖了，所以打算减肥。
items.translation_en: I've gained weight, so I'm thinking of going on a diet.

items.translation: 天气预报说明天下午会晴。
items.translation_en: The forecast said it will clear up tomorrow afternoon.

items.translation_en: A: “What should we do? Take a taxi?” B: “We have time, so let's walk.”

items.translation_en: A: “Yamada takes a lot of days off.” B: “Yes. I'm thinking of telling him to stop taking time off.”

items.translation_en: If you're going to China, please buy some tea.

items.translation_en: A: “We'll know the exam results soon.” B: “Yes. If I don't pass, I plan to take it again next year.”

items.translation_en: Husband: “I'm just going to the bookstore.” Wife: “Oh. If you're going out, could you buy eggs on the way back?”

items.translation_en: Wife: “What about laundry today?” Husband: “It looks like bad weather tomorrow, so you'd better do it today.”

items.translation_en: I heard cheap computers break easily — will it be okay?

items.translation_en: Doctor: “How's the foot? Still hurt?” Patient: “If I keep walking it starts to hurt, but it's fine now.”

items.translation: 开始学唱歌之后，每天都变有趣了。
